quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-05-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 2,373,461 million (+5.6% YoY), operating profit JPY 153,021 million (+28.2%), ordinary profit JPY 155,516 million (+27.8%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 97,938 million (+29.3%). Segment sales / operating profit: Environment and Energy JPY 536,010 million (+3.8%) / JPY 34,461 million (+JPY 2,921 million); Infocommunications JPY 135,423 million (+30.7%) / JPY 22,075 million (+JPY 17,213 million), on higher demand for data-center optical devices, optical wiring equipment and optical cable driven by the generative-AI market, plus better product mix and productivity; Automotive JPY 1,378,233 million (+5.6%) / JPY 65,405 million (+JPY 10,379 million); Electronics JPY 197,257 million (+3.0%, firm FPC demand from a major customer) / JPY 17,986 million (-JPY 242 million, partly on yen appreciation); Industrial Materials and others JPY 188,237 million (+1.4%) / JPY 12,903 million (+JPY 3,374 million). H1 R&D JPY 82,344 million; payments for property, plant and equipment JPY 110,813 million. Management said it would talk carefully with customers to minimise the earnings impact of the additional US tariffs.
